title: Run the real-quest race suite in CI: install quest from QUEST_SOURCE_REF in the test job
description: From the 0.14.0 release (team-lead relay 2026-10-13); NOT part of that release. test/link-quest-race.test.ts (LCLI-614) uses test.skipIf(Bun.which("quest") === null) and CI's lint/typecheck/test job installs no quest, so all three real-quest cases are skipped on ubuntu and windows (run 38398294943 shows them as skip) and CI has never exercised the suite. The test job should install quest from QUEST_SOURCE_REF (the same setup-quest action the docs gate uses) so the suite runs. Prove it both ways.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CI test job installs quest at the version CLAUDE.md declares, and the three real-quest cases in test/link-quest-race.test.ts report pass, not skip, on a matched lore/quest pair
The same job goes red, with those cases failing on the pair lock, when the installed quest does not match lore's version, shown by a recorded run
A guard fails the job if those cases are skipped there, so quest disappearing from PATH cannot silently turn them back into skips
